node.title: (LA-EQ) and the layer-A geometry counterexamples
node.closure: constructive refutation of two hypothesis rungs, plus an infinite fence family
node.statement: (LA-EQ): for any hypothesis set H satisfied by the restriction of a strict A=3, e=m endpoint configuration to 7m-1 of its at least 15m parameter-saturated points, (LA-W COUNT | H) implies the endpoint is empty, because the endpoint's own nonzero kernel biform lies in the layer-A kernel of the restriction; the rank theorem is therefore a strict strengthening of the exclusion rather than a route to it. Two hypothesis rungs are constructively FALSE at m = 2: the closed form Q = (Z-g)(Z-h)C(X) + a(Z-h)sigma_g(X) - b(Z-g)sigma_h(X) satisfies H1 by construction with two degree-rho supports split over mu_32, |S_g ^ S_h| = 1 and a = 13 = 7m-1 saturated points, and every admissible build has layer-A nullity exactly 1 against a count excess 3m^2-5m = +2; forcing H2 (all pair intersections at most m-1, T = rho+2 = 9 exactly) still admits exhibits with supports [7,7,2,2,2,2,2,1,1], max pair-intersection 1 and nullity 1, obtained by prescribing the five merged second-slope values, which makes the merge conditions linear in C and leaves 10 equations on 9 unknowns, i.e. one scalar condition. The fence is an infinite family: Q_0 = Z^m - X^{2m} with W inside 4 fibres of x -> x^{2m} on mu_{16m} and Gamma the 4m m-th roots plus one spare gives a saturated a = 7m-1 configuration of nullity exactly 2m, verified afresh at m = 3 (60 x 48, rank 42, nullity 6). Consequently the bare count route is dead at every m >= 2, the standalone universal layer-A exclusion at a = 7m-1 is retired, and the surviving question -- rank over (SAT2)-completable configurations -- IS the realizability question.
